params.prompt: A frame grabbed from a Korean sitcom video, 9:16 vertical: candid mid-action, not a posed photo. Evening living room (warm lamps, string lights, arched window dark navy), fixed tripod camera at eye level, natural skin, no text, no watermark. The first reference image is the exact face to keep (identity must match), the second the outfit sheet, the third the room and sofa. Medium shot: the man (29, Korean, round gold wire glasses, jet-black two-block hair, navy overshirt open over a white T-shirt, company ID badge on a navy lanyard, grey trousers) at the right end of the caramel corduroy sofa, one hand pressed flat on his chest, eyes closed for a beat, chin lifted, sincerely defending something precious, a cream knit cushion beside him.
